Title: Arrival
Walk_Bus: Rideshare from the airport with luggage. Bus is hard with bags.
Rideshare: About $30 to $40 from HNL to Waikiki.
Places: Honolulu International Airport; Waikiki Malia by Outrigger

Title: Diamond Head and Waikiki
Walk_Bus: Walk to Diamond Head for the 5:30 AM sunrise (book the State Parks slot). Sweet Home Cafe, Waiola shave ice, Waikiki Beach, sunset at Kapiolani Park.
Rideshare: Rideshare to Diamond Head, about $12 to $18 each way.
Tour: Waikiki Trolley 1-day pass, about $55 to $65 per adult.
Places: Diamond Head State Monument; Sweet Home Cafe; Waiola Shave Ice; Kapiolani Park

Title: Pearl Harbor
Walk_Bus: TheBus Route 20 to Pearl Harbor. Arizona Memorial on your recreation.gov reservation. Optional Aiea Loop in the morning.
Rideshare: About $40 to $60 round trip for both.
Car_Backup: Car for one day from a Waikiki branch, no hotel parking.
Tour: Pearl Harbor tours include the memorial; compare prices.
Places: Pearl Harbor Visitor Center; Maunakea Marketplace; Aiea Loop Trailhead

Title: Hanauma Bay
Walk_Bus: TheBus to Hanauma Bay (reservation required). Walk about 20 minutes from the stop. Koko Crater only if open. Rainbow Drive-In dinner.
Car_Backup: Easy by car, with parking at Hanauma.
Tour: Snorkel tours also run to Hanauma; book early.
Places: Hanauma Bay Nature Preserve; Koko Head District Park; Rainbow Drive-In

Title: North Shore
Walk_Bus: TheBus Route 60 to Haleiwa, Waimea Valley, shrimp truck, Matsumoto Shave Ice. Allow 2 to 3 hours each way.
Rideshare: About $90 or more each way. Plan ahead.
Car_Backup: Good car day: Dole, Waimea, Haleiwa, Sunset Beach.
Tour: Circle Island tour (Fil-Am about $37.50 per person, or Aina Tours). Includes Dole.
Places: Waimea Valley; Haleiwa Town; Giovanni's Shrimp Truck; Matsumoto Shave Ice; Dole Plantation

Title: Manoa Falls and Kapahulu
Walk_Bus: TheBus Route 13 to the Manoa Falls trailhead. Walk the rainforest trail, then walk to Kapahulu for Leonard's and Ono Seafood.
Places: Manoa Falls Trailhead; Leonard's Bakery; Ono Seafood

Title: Makapu'u and whales
Walk_Bus: TheBus to Makapu'u Point for sunrise. Lighthouse trail (2 miles round trip). Watch whales from shore or walk to Kewalo Basin.
Car_Backup: Early car arrival; Makapu'u parking fills up.
Tour: Whale-watching cruise from Kewalo Basin, about $150 for two.
Places: Makapu'u Lighthouse Trail; Kewalo Basin; Ramen Nakamura

Title: Lanikai and Kailua
Walk_Bus: TheBus to Kailua. Walk to the Lanikai Pillbox (short, steep, sunrise). Kailua Beach Park. Kalapawai Cafe. Maunawili Falls optional.
Rideshare: About $70 to $100 for Lanikai, Pali Lookout, and Maunawili Falls.
Car_Backup: Early car helps for Pillbox parking.
Places: Lanikai Pillbox Trail; Kailua Beach Park; Kalapawai Cafe; Maunawili Falls; Nuuanu Pali Lookout

Title: Windward day
Walk_Bus: TheBus to Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden and Kawainui Marsh. A relaxed day.
Rideshare: About $100 to $180 for Byodo-In and Ho'omaluhia.
Car_Backup: Car day: Byodo-In, Ho'omaluhia, and Kawainui in one loop.
Tour: Windward or circle tour covers Byodo-In.
Places: Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden; Kawainui Marsh; Byodo-In Temple; Kailua Beach Park

Title: Slow Waikiki day
Walk_Bus: Walk Waikiki, Kuhio Beach, plate lunch. Optional Iolani Palace on TheBus Route 20.
Rideshare: About $80 or more each way to Makaha.
Car_Backup: Car day for Makaha Beach Park and the west side.
Tour: Waikiki Trolley 1-day pass, about $55 to $65 per adult.
Places: Kuhio Beach; Royal Hawaiian Center; Iolani Palace; Makaha Beach Park

Title: Departure day
Walk_Bus: Tantalus sunrise by rideshare. Bishop Museum by TheBus. Check out at noon, store bags. Punchbowl, then airport by rideshare.
Rideshare: Rideshare for Tantalus, Punchbowl, and the airport.
Car_Backup: Return the car at the airport or a Waikiki branch.
Places: Pu'u Ualaka'a State Park; Bishop Museum; National Memorial Cemetery of the Pacific; Honolulu International Airport
